program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const m = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = u - g * t; const height = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const acceleration = -g; const force = m * g; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); let motionState = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (t > apexTime) { motionState = "Falling"; } if (height < 0.01 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } const maxH = 2.2; const scaleY = (h) => 320 - (h / maxH) * 260; const ballY = scaleY(Math.max(0, Math.min(maxH, height))); const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 30, w: 290, h: 360, title: "The motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 50, y: 350, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: 5, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 150, ballY, 26, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 150, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 175, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(195, ballY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(velocity) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(acceleration) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + sdk.format(force) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); const totalDur = 2 * apexTime; const pts = []; const steps = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) { const st = (i / steps) * Math.max(1.8, totalDur); const sv = u - g * st; pts.push({ x: st, y: sv }); } objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 30, w: 290, h: 360, title: "Velocity over time", state: "v = u - gt" })); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 350, y: 80, w: 250, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: pts }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 350, 320, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, mass: m, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and force remain constant.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed vertically. At the top, its velocity is zero, but the velocity-time slope and acceleration remain equal to -g, and the gravitational force equals mg.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
